subject.title: feat: add external archive provider sync

question: Should Slacrawl permanently support third-party external archive providers through this subprocess JSONL contract and provider configuration surface?
rationale: The change establishes a new extension and persisted-sync contract whose long-term API, security, and support boundary cannot be settled by source review and tests alone.

options.title: Approve the provider direction
options.body: Sponsor this configuration and protocol contract, then require runtime and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Request a smaller provider boundary or explicit compatibility guarantees before accepting the new sync surface.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Pause the PR if external archive integration should remain outside the core sync product for now.

recommendation.title: Approve the provider direction
recommendation.body: Sponsor this configuration and protocol contract, then require runtime and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored both supplied feature commits and is the only concrete implementation-history signal provided for this new subsystem.
